title: Jim Simons
html: Who: Mathematician who founded Renaissance; its Medallion fund is widely regarded as the best track record in investing history. Core ideas: Markets have small, repeatable patterns; models and data beat intuition; never override the system on emotion. Read: The Man Who Solved the Market (Gregory Zuckerman). For our plan: Write rules in advance (contribution day, selloff rules) and follow them mechanically. Deep dive: Medallion Fund Back to Council of Masters
